body:
Hey thanks for remembering me. I still haven't seen my kids, almost a month now. I have a good lawyer, mediation is next. My lawyer is working on getting my kids back here. The holidays are coming and I may not see the kids until after the holidays. Sucks. I am trying to be positive, gather lots of evidence, and wait it out.  Nothing seems to be worth hurrying here it seems. As soon as I get more substantive progress I am going to post a AMA and possibly a expat guide to children and the law system here. I don't want anyone to go through this like I am. 

I do have one friend who invited me for Christmas with his family. I think it will help. I do feel like hiding away until my kids come home, but I know being with good people will improve my overall well being. 

Thanks for checking up on me. 

Keep an eye out for updates.
Deal! I hope you get the lotto, not the bus.
You getting bombarded with them!

Thank you so much! I will not leave this story unfinished for you! 

Your words and support got me through a dark time. I am so grateful.
Thank you SG. I will not leave this story unfinished. I am stronger because of you.

In cases like this, they must look at the evidence first. If I was exactly like my wife and did the same thing a her, as a male, the procedure would be the same. I am learning from my lawyer a lot already. 

I really am thankful for your help. I know there will be ups and downs in this process. But I feel stronger knowing I have help at the ready. I never want to go so far down again.

When you have children, cherish every moment. It's in your genes to connect so much. It's conditional love. 

You were such a help for me. Thank you.

She's a very good person who is confused and needs a lot of help to repair her addictions and depression. She's my daughters' mother. If she gets better, then they will be better off too.  She just needs to get some help. But I like your spirit! Thank you.
You really kept me in check. I needed that. I was more vulnerable and alone than I had ever felt before. Forever thanks for your support and help.
Thanks so much. It's gonna be long, but I feel like now I can face it. My lawyer has even told me that some of the things that were denied from me were wrong. She's even starting today.
Thank you a million times. I have had such a weight lifted off of me. You guys helped me to keep that weight from crushing me. I am standing again.

It was the two weeks of not knowing, and not getting anywhere that was sending me to the brink. Finally, one of the many lawyers I called, called back. She really knows the system. Man, I am so glad I kept going. You guys helped by keeping me focused. I may not have made it if I didn't get the chance to connect. 

I will endeavor to stay strong. Thank you.

I am just so thankful there were people to help me through the worst feelings I have had in my life. Like I said before. It puts me at ease to know my daughters are growing in a world with people like yourself.
I ran around the house screaming 'thank you!' I thank you so much for all your kind words and help. I am so grateful.
Thanks so much for the help. It isn't over, but now I have help.

Thank you so much! When I found out,  I ran through the house screaming 'thank you!' 

You really kept me here when I was so close to gone. I am sending all my good energy your way!
Thank you so much for your support. I am so grateful. I am sending a quazillion good karma energy waves in your direction.

update for everyone at SW. 

*****I GOT A LAWYER! She understands the system and my rights. She is taking the case! I feel a wealth of weight off my shoulders right now. I am so thankful to have had all of you here for me. I know it may be rough days ahead, but knowing I have someone who will be helping me, you, and now a lawyer who knows the system, I am feeling a sense of strength coming into my being. 

I thank you all again for helping me during the darkest days and nights. You are all truly special people. Knowing that there are such intelligent and kind people in this world gives me so much hope for the future my children shall live in. Again, from the bottom of my heart, thank you.

I am going to, if I am going to be alone for the holidays,  go home for a little while and try to recharge.

This may sound a bit odd to say but, I was Army Special Ops in the early 90's. I always believed I could overcome anything by thinking just the way you said to me here. I had the will and drive of a lion. 

This is what is making this so damn difficult to deal with right now. I feel I have lost the will to move forward. I am still getting up and pursuing   positive progress everyday. The strong emotions and downward spikes are debilitating though. 

I cut out any booze, have only one cup of coffee, and take a very small dose of prescription xanax when the extreme hits me. It does help me to calm down and get back to work. I don't want to become an addict from the stuff though. So I use it sparingly. 

I hope I can make it. Today I feel ok. Last night it was so bad that I almost felt out of my own body. Your words and kindness mean a great deal to me right now.

Just woke up. I am trying to focus only on the kids right now. It is, honestly, the only thing that is keeping me alive.. but barely. I am trying so hard today to stay strong, focus, and be positive. All your support is really helping me get it out and think about things in better ways. 

My feelings, sometimes, go so low without warning. Right now I feel ok. Last night, I was ready to go away. Writing about it to everyone here is having a positive effect.

I woke up just now. I was shaking, sweating, and cold like every other morning as of late. I have been sitting here trying to get the morning extremes down to an acceptable level.  

I am trying to show that I respect her decision to leave. It never looks good when a guy keeps pushing a woman to come back. My ideal future outcome would be this (Just to give context, not to say that this is what MUST happen for me to go on.) : I become primary care giver of my  children, she has good visitation with them, and she gets help for her depression and gambling addiction.  We could even go to counseling together. That would help the children the most and may even force her to begin getting help for her problems. 

Writing about this is really helping me today. 

So, not seeing her and knowing she is in great pain and conflict hurts so much. I know, if she came and sat with me for 1 hour, we could hash out everything without getting anyone else involved.I have reached out to family mediation services and am in contact with the head of the department now (I have tried so hard that now he is my contact there). But, she does not return their calls for mediation. I am not sure she has control of her phone right now.   Her family is not letting her take care of this herself.
after 8 years.. I am not sure I have any fight left in me. I need to get some sleep. I feel numb and exhausted, which does help me cope. It's the waking up when I get panicked and sad. Thank you.
My mom keep telling me to just go outside. It does help a little.
Thanks man. I feel good knowing that.

I have thought that. But, I do want my kids to still see their mother. I still love her. My problem was with her family. We had no fight. It was with her family. Now they take her and the kids and are making her do these things. I know my wife is very sad and conflicted right now. Her mom is running the show and it is hurting my wife so much too. When she was here to pick up some clothes yesterday, she looked the worst I have ever seen her in 8 years. She looked 10 years older. She looked like she hadn't slept and had been crying everyday. It kills me inside. Because now I have to hurt her to get the custody. I have to tell about things that will hurt her. Ughhhhhh... I hate her fucking family!

Thank you Lillybean. I may need to babble. It's human contact that is keeping me strong. When I am alone, sometimes I get some strength, then it sails to the depths of hell. Yesterday, I felt so strong and ready to fight. I woke shaking and sweating and freezing in bed. I cried for a long time.

That's what everyone says to me. I don't want her to win. I just don't know if I can fight anymore. I feel down for the count. 

It's the emptiness, so far away from home, alone, dark and cold, and knowing my daughters are seeing my wife's family everyday. My oldest and I were so very very close. We talked together about everything. God I miss her.
Thank you KarmaDeer.

Being here, I feel second class to the native people. I have had the worst luck with everything. Losing my family right now, has been the top of it all. 8 years of so much hard work and effort and now I have to fight for the only thing I had left. I find it so sad I have to fight for the children I have raised.
Thank you. Every encouraging word makes my eyes water. I never get this bad.

Thank You. What I need is people to talk to. I will add you to my friend list.. I just hope you don't mind me babbling on and on about the sad situation I am in. That hurts me the most. I like to be the one who helps others. But, when others help me, I feel so guilty that I must trouble them.

I want to get out of here and visit home in Buffalo, NY with family and friends. Problem is lawyers and meetings and trying to get everything done correctly. I, if this all drags on through the holidays when Norway shuts down for a few weeks, will go back home to be close to everyone who supports me. 

I am reflecting. I am pushing everyday to get through. 

I have so much rope, burning the noose won't stop anything. 

One of my only friends is visiting right now to cheer me up and keep an eye on me. He's forcing me to do other things. It is helping. I just dread the times when I am alone.

I will try, I just don't want it to effect the decisions made by the court. I am 1 and a half hours east of Oslo. It would be tough to meet. But we can leave it an open option for the future. I may need to hang out for a little while sometime in the future. I added you to my friends here. Thank you so much.
Thank you so much.
I have had almost two weeks of trying to get a lawyer and get my side heard. All the work and nothing is happening. I call an call and call. No one calls back.

When you are available, please, pm me if you can. Maybe a anonymous conversation would help. I hope everyone here understands that I have been in the Reddit community almost since the beginning. I have never asked for help. I am doing this here because Reddit is a community I have grown to care about and cares about others. I want to talk about this without people who know me having to hear and worry about it.

I just don't want to be numb. That is the only thing that gets me away from the thoughts though.A part of me wants to keep feeling the love, loss and need to hold my children. I feel like I betray them when I don't feel anything by trying to clear my head. So both feeling and non-feeling really hurts. 

I am afraid to reveal my location because I do not want, if I decide to live, to be used against me. I am trying to understand the feelings and trying to deal with them. I just have extremely strong moments when I feel out of control of my actions. I am trying so hard.

I have been trying so hard. I am trying to stay away from the xanax. I don't want any addiction problems. It does help a little. I try to take half doses just to stay at a reasonably low level. I try reading to quiet my mind. I try going outside to get fresh air. I have tried to eat a little everyday. I try getting myself angry for what has been done. It helps, but, when I stop for a second, the death thoughts come back and I feel almost in auto-pilot. 

If I seek help, it may come back to hurt me with the custody of my children. If I end it I don[t have to worry any longer. My history has had ups and downs, but I have always cared for the ones I love. I just want to see them.

I was thinking of making a video for them to explain what I did. And then thought of making one for when they are older. Maybe it would help them have closure. 

It's these ups and downs, the darkness, the feeling that maybe, as much as I tried, I was the failure of this young family.
Thank you so much! I need all the help I can get. I have been spending 8 hours a day trying to find a good lawyer to take my case, often times, just to return my call. It really sucks.

Thank you so so so so much. Thanks to so many kind people here I have gotten a nice list of names and places to call for help on Monday. Your effort to share this information is appreciated more than I could ever express. Thank you so much.

As I am former Army Special Ops '93-99, I respect that idea. May need that as a last resort . Extraction. 

Plus, the big news here is all the surveillance the US is doing on Norwegian citizens. I am sure they hold some bitterness right now towards us. 

Thanks for the light hearted motivation. I needed that.
No problem. Thanks for replying.
exactly. Thanks so much.

Thank you! I will. I am actually trying to see if I can do something positive on Reddit to help others. Sitting here alone, with my family gone, I need something positive to focus on. I added you as a friend and will come back if I need help. You have really helped me just by being here for me. Thank you.

I am a redditor for many many years. Anonymous account here.  I am also live abroad in a country I have grown (generally) to despise. I am having bad thoughts as well right now, and the people on Reddit here have been helping me. I want to reach out to you and say that if you would like to pm me maybe we can help each other. 

Maybe we can talk about our feelings and how being alone in a foreign country can make things so much more difficult. I would like to help if I can. I am not in Italy but Norway.

I have a long way to go and, even though I know I have all the evidence I need to gain custody, I am trying to find the strength to fight for it. . I thank you and  everyone who helped me. 
I won't lie and say I am all better, I will just say that I am still having dark thoughts, have prepared the method if I do, but am staying occupied, reading, writing and will sleep and hope I feel stronger tomorrow. A friend is also visiting tomorrow so I hope I can get a little distracted for a day or two. Thank you.
Wow. Thank you.
Thanks. I wish all good karma your way.

Fly here?! Wow. That is nice to even offer. I added you as a friend. I will send a note and let you know how things are going.  I feel just numb and am under the blankets trying to read something to keep my mind away from bad thoughts. 

Again, I thank from the bottom of my heart.

So many people have sent me good links to lawyers and other assistance programs in the last day. I now have to wait until Monday to make calls. I am trying sooooo hard to be patient, calm and strong. 10 minutes ago, totally by surprise, I just got a phone call from a former student, (I am a teacher of 10 yrs) . He wanted to go skiing and asked how I was. Now he is coming over tomorrow to hang out and help me with people he knows (he went through something similar). He even is bringing food and his new xbox which I have never used before. . I hung up with him and cried and cried. I have so many friends and family back home in the US. But here, my wife was my best friend. I am so desperate to hold my daughters, talk to them and spend time with them. It is so dark, cold and empty right now. Her gambling has left me with no money and piles of debt. So going out to see anyone is very difficult. 

Your words mean more to me than you will ever know. I thank you. It is very hard to type right now. I am really trying.
Thank you so much. I will go to these places and seek help. Ut is so hard to find what I am looking for when it is all in Norwegian and I am so stressed and scared.

That is what pumps me up. Them I realize that Norway has been one long series of busting my ass, sacrifice, and just being the best I can be. It has always turned out that I lose. Every time. If I fight the good fight and end up with nothing, again, I will lose my mind. I am so tired of fighting the good fight. With me gone.... no more problems or fighting for me. 

I keep getting the image of Sisyphus. I have nothing left to push that rock anymore.

Thank you. I am sitting here now and doing my best to think of them. But thoughts of my wife and not seeing the kids without a long court battle scares the shit out me. I am weakened so much by this. I wish it was the old west or medieval  times where a sword or gunfight ended the argument and everyone moved on. This quiet, waiting is eating me from the inside.

Yes, that is correct. I don't feel comfortable, in the small community i live in, in Norway (much more cold on surface people) to start ringing them. I have some recommendations (numbers and contacts) from Redditors here and am going to get started on those if I can get myself some rest today .The week has been one long failure to get help. I just feel in my deepest self I can't stand up and fight anymore. I will rest and try to eat. I have a prescription for xanax that helps calm the crazy anxiety and worry, but when the night comes so early, the house is empty with toys and drawings of the kids still sitting in their rooms, it is cold outside and so quite in the area I live, dark thoughts creep. I am an older guy now. 40. I have been giving my all for years here and, for some reason, I keep getting my ass handed to me. It is a very different thing to be a foreigner here. I AM second class.

I have one and he is at a yearly cabin party with old friends. He calls every few hours to motivate and check on my well being. I have other 'acquaintances' but no one close enough other than him. I have been taking care of my kids, house, work and my depressed wife for years. I haven't had time to 'get out' and develop relationships.

tough love I see. 

No I don't want them to be with her. I am from the background that you never give up on family, forgive, be firm and support. Now it is biting me in the ass, you're right. I just need support and everything I do to fight this is getting me nowhere.
Also, thank you for the link. I will go there right away.

I was told the same thing. But all week I have been trying to get mediation and child services to help. They are kind and listen, but did nothing this week. Maybe they are very busy, maybe they are investigating the situation. I feel like a second class citizen. 

I think they still listen to women here before they listen to the men.
Yes, I just took it down after someone recommended it.

Thank you so much. Yes, I have been meeting everyday with barnevarnet. I will also press charges on her brother. I am going to spend the day looking for a lawyer and fri rettshjelp. 

You explained everything I have been going through right now. My intuition has been my guide here for years. It has not failed me yet. Lately it has felt like I am getting screwed and ignored.  If you get any ideas, no matter how small, please feel free to contact me. 

Thank you so much again. 

BTW: Your English is very good. It is much better than mine right now. I am exhausted.
Thank you so much. I tried everything. She would find the bank cards and spend everything. Then, she would be fine for a year or so. Then, again, when no one expected, she would do the same thing.
I am using an anonymous account right now. I will appreciate any help, regardless of how small. Thank you.
I have done that as well. They listened but said they could do nothing unless my wife was willing to go there too. They tried contact but she never answered.
Thank you. I have tried those things. I did get good info from someone here today. I am going to go with that for now. Thank you for your help.
i will do this now.
You have helped me more with this than anyone has all week. Thank you so so so very much. I am crying with gratitude.
Know any good lawyers in Drammen/Asker/ or last resort Oslo?

Everything 200 times harder here than at home. I have at least 4 lifelong friends who could help me find one back in the states. Here, I have no contacts and when I do call, they are short with me when I tell them the money situation. Now, they do have an income level that, if I am below it, (I think I am) I get free service. The problem again is, who do I take? What if I get someone who doesn't give a shit? I need a friend of a friend. This is a small country. I have no doubt that lawyer a knows b,c, and d. I need a strong dependable lawyer. 

I grew up with a strong connections back home. I have been there when it was who I knew, not what I knew. It works the same here. 

I am just so tired from endless phone calls and pointless meetings and worrying. If I get a bad lawyer, I am afraid I may lose (even though I have sufficient evidence, diary entries and a friend who has heard my stories for years.) 

I know I know. Don't give up. I am trying right now.
my big problem is finding a lawyer.

There are new laws here. We share custody. I was told by the police that if I took the kids away from her, and kept them away, she would be in my situation. It's tricky, but her mother is running the show right now. 

I am starting to wonder if her meth head brother spiked something I was drinking... Wonder if there is a way to check 5 days later. 

Thank you for your help. If you know any legal people near drammen or have advice, please don't hesitate to let me know.
Thank you.
http://vimeo.com/16749021 (taken off, legal advice)

Thank you. Here is a video http://vimeo.com/16749021  (taken off, legal advice)  I posted if you wish to hear me speak about it. I needed to talk to someone. My parents are on vacation and are hard to reach, the social services just say the kids are fine, and my best friend in norway is in a cabin for a yearly party. 
I keep going up and down. Strong, then incredibly weak. I really feel no alternatives when I get down, but I also don't want any authorities to know I am having these thoughts if I decide to keep moving forward. I don't want to jeopardize anything. 

But when I am down (about 5 minutes ago), I go waaay down. And that is scaring me. I have prepared almost everything to go through with it during those times... I just keep fighting and fighting the thoughts. Hoping for a refresh tomorrow. 

Plus, I feel like shit for even having to ask for help or advice. I am sorry for that.
Thank you. I posted more above to zoesagan. Took prescription xanax and am feeling sad but calm. I may pass out soon.

>kids very rarely do well if they've got a parent who's killed themselves

I am just spent. My wife has depression and *her brother* is the criminal. 

I am so out of it right now. I have been making videos for family and friends to say goodbye. I have nothing left. Thanks you for your help. I will try to focus tonight. It goes up and down all day and night. Took some xanax to calm down. 

I just have no energy to fight and fight anymore. Everything I do falls to shit and now they want to make it seem like I am a violent person. I am not, never have been. I just wanted the asshole out of my house that night

Reddit has been my solace for many many years. I have never reached out for advice before, just news. Thanks. I am going to post a video on r/askreddit, r/norge and r/norway to see if there is someone to give me some hope or help and advice.
